text:
lia: quick flag 1 - search returned two different pages for 'dedicated scale' and users hit the wrong one intermittently. docs-bot's weekly scan highlighted a duplicate slug. screenshot attached in thread.

kevin: do you have the file paths? can repro locally?

lia: repro steps: `curl -s \"https://internal.kb/search?q=dedicated+scale\" | grep -A1 scale` - shows both `/deploy/dedicated/scale` pointing to content/kb/dedicated/scale.md and content/kb/legacy/dedicated-scale.md.

maria: ah, legacy placeholder from 2022 migration. i added it while porting guides and forgot to add a redirect. thanks for the catch. cc @docs-bot

sam: short plan: canonicalize to content/kb/dedicated/scale.md, add redirect_from on the legacy file, mark legacy as archived, and migrate any useful deprecated note into canonical guide. avoids broken inbound links.

kevin: i can open the redirect PR and run a repo-wide grep to update internal links if needed. who reviews?

maria: i'll review the legacy->redirect change. legacy has two small deprecated paragraphs worth folding into the canonical guide first. happy to migrate after the redirect PR.

lia: proposed steps: (1) kevin opens PR to add redirect and archived flag on legacy; (2) run `git grep` for references to legacy path and update internal links; (3) migrate the two paragraphs into canonical doc and add changelog line.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2251 — title: "kb: redirect legacy dedicated-scale -> canonical; mark archived". included issue KB-421 from docs-bot in PR body. added frontmatter snippet in diff.

sam: can you paste the exact frontmatter you added so deploy-lint CI will validate it?

kevin: sure: `---
slug: /deploy/dedicated/scale
archived: true
redirect_from: ["/deploy/dedicated/scale"]
---` — included in PR diff.

maria: tiny style nit: move `archived` below `slug`? not critical. i'll do the migration PR once this merges.

kevin: done, moved and pushed. CI green.

maria: merged. i created follow-up PR to copy the two deprecated paragraphs into the canonical guide and add a changelog entry: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2252. left a short attribution line.

lia: search looks stable now on my end. thanks for the quick async turnaround.

docs-bot: automated note: duplicate-slug issue KB-421 tracked. will close when follow-up migration PR merges and next weekly scan shows no duplicates.

sam: i'll wait for PR 2252 to merge then re-run the scan and close KB-421. thanks all for the quick coordination :rocket:
